name: trading212-controlled
description: Trading 212 portfolio tools with separately previewed and confirmed market orders.
long_description: A local Trading 212 MCP server. Account data stays in your Trading 212 account and credentials are stored in your operating system's secure credential store.

trading212_api_key.title: Trading 212 API key
trading212_api_key.description: Your personal Trading 212 API key ID. It is stored securely by Claude Desktop and is never included in this extension.

trading212_api_secret.title: Trading 212 API secret
trading212_api_secret.description: The secret paired with your personal API key. It is stored securely by Claude Desktop and is never included in this extension.

environment.title: Trading environment
environment.description: Use live for a real Invest or Stocks ISA account, or demo for paper trading.
